subject.title: feat(sandbox): add skipSkillsSync config option to suppress skill sync

question: Should OpenClaw sponsor `agents.*.sandbox.docker.skipSkillsSync` as a public advanced-deployment contract, and if so must preinstalled skills use one enforced `${containerWorkdir}/skills` layout?
rationale: The PR adds permanent public configuration and changes who owns the integrity and availability of instructions presented to sandboxed agents; implementation mechanics cannot decide that product and security boundary.

options.title: Sponsor an exact-root contract
options.body: Accept the Docker-only option after enforcing and validating one sandbox skill root, aligning documentation, and adding current-head live proof.

options.title: Use a backend capability
options.body: Replace the user-facing toggle with a backend-declared capability that supplies a verified materialized skill root.

options.title: Decline the option
options.body: Keep managed synchronization as the sole supported invariant and close this PR and its linked feature request.

recommendation.title: Sponsor an exact-root contract
recommendation.body: Accept the Docker-only option after enforcing and validating one sandbox skill root, aligning documentation, and adding current-head live proof.

likelyOwner.reason: Their sandbox backend and operator-contract history makes them the strongest available owner for deciding whether this public setting belongs in OpenClaw.
